relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, PCB126 elevated the protein levels of MMP-9 and ERβ in endometriotic lesions

relationships.subject: PCB-126
relationships.evidence_quote: PCB126 (0.1 nM) significantly increased ERβ transcriptional activity compared to the vehicle (Fig. 2E), whereas it did not induce ERα activity

relationships.subject: PCB-126
relationships.evidence_quote: PCB126 (0.1 nM) significantly increased GAS6 mRNA levels in both IHEECs (Fig. 4A) and IHESCs (Fig. 4B).

relationships.subject: BMS-777607
relationships.evidence_quote: BMS-777607 treatment significantly reduced the volume of endometriotic lesions in PCB126-exposed mice compared to the vehicle-treated group

relationships.subject: ERβ
relationships.evidence_quote: ERβ functions as a key transcriptional regulator that directly upregulates Dnmt3a expression in the uterine endometrium

key_findings: PCB-126 promotes endometriosis via SRC-1 isoform/MMP-9/ERβ and AXL/GAS6 activation of ERβ.
ERβ upregulates DNMT3A, and endometrial Dnmt3a knockout shrinks lesions and reduces cytokines.
